chunks: And We have sent you with the truth to give glad tidings and to warn. You will not be questioned about those and who are inmates of Hell.
ai.seo_question: What is the Prophet's role regarding those in Hell according to Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis to delineate the Prophet's specific duties from divine judgment, underscores that his role is limited to conveying the message with truth, without being accountable for the ultimate fate of the disbelievers. It highlights the theological principle of 'la taklif illa bi-l-qudra' (no burden beyond capacity) regarding the Prophet's intercession and accountability, reinforcing his status as a clear warner rather than the ultimate arbiter of Hellfire. This distinction is crucial in understanding the Shia view of the Prophet's infallibility and his precise boundaries of responsibility.
